metadata.short_desc: Mute users who repeat the same message; global + per-group thresholds and custom notice text
metadata.desc: Counts how many times the same message is repeated within a time window and mutes when the threshold is reached. Thresholds, window, mute duration and the notice template can be configured from the plugin page, or overridden per group in QQ via the /刷屏 commands.

same_message_only.description: Only count repeats of the same message
same_message_only.hint: On: trigger only when the same content repeats to the threshold. Off: any N messages in the window trigger

only_chat_messages.hint: When off, notice events (recall, admin changes, joins, poke, etc.) are counted too

window_seconds.hint: Repeats of the same message are counted within this window

max_messages.description: Repeats of the same message that trigger a mute
max_messages.hint: Triggers when reached; total message count when same_message_only is off

text_normalize.description: Ignore case and whitespace when comparing text
text_normalize.hint: Treats "hahaha" and "ha haha" as the same message

mute_seconds.hint: 0 means only count and notify, no real mute

cooldown_seconds.hint: Avoid repeated mutes in a short time

notify.description: Send a notice in the group when triggered
